# Hi, I'm Miles!

Living and coding in the heart of Buenos Aires, I'm a systems software engineer with a passion for low-level shenanigans and building things that run fast and scale well. I spend most of my days (and nights) diving deep into Rust, WebAssembly, and Tokio, crafting solutions that push the boundaries of what's possible.

### What I'm Into
- Building resilient systems that can handle the chaos of the internet
- Exploring the WebAssembly ecosystem to make the web a more powerful platform
- Taming async code with Tokio to make concurrent programming less terrifying
